## Findings
- claim-1: Assuming the accepted graded basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z\,e_\rho\), with \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), one has \[ H_Q(z)=z^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|} =z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_z. \]
- claim-2: The formula \[ \rho^\vee=(b-\rho_a,\ldots,b-\rho_1) \] is an involution on partitions in \(b^a\) and satisfies \[ |\rho^\vee|=ab-|\rho|. \]
- claim-3: The integral bilinear form \[ \langle e_\rho,e_\sigma\rangle=\delta_{\sigma,\rho^\vee} \] is a perfect degree-complement pairing \[ Q_d\times Q_{\,2ij+ab-d}\longrightarrow\mathbb Z. \]
## Strategy
Assume the accepted graded basis
\[
Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho,\qquad \deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|.
\]
Thus
\[
H_Q(z)=\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{ij+|\rho|}
=z^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}.
\]

Let \(P_{a,b}(z)=\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}\), with partitions padded by trailing zeroes to length \(a\). For \(a,b\ge1\), splitting according as \(\rho_1<b\) or \(\rho_1=b\) gives
\[
P_{a,b}=P_{a,b-1}+z^bP_{a-1,b}. \tag{1}
\]
Also \(P_{0,b}=P_{a,0}=1\).

Put
\[
F_{a,b}(z)=\prod_{t=1}^{a}\frac{1-z^{b+t}}{1-z^t}
=\binom{a+b}{a}_z.
\]
Directly from this product,
\[
F_{a,b-1}=F_{a,b}\frac{1-z^b}{1-z^{a+b}},
\qquad
F_{a-1,b}=F_{a,b}\frac{1-z^a}{1-z^{a+b}},
\]
and hence
\[
F_{a,b-1}+z^bF_{a-1,b}
=F_{a,b}\frac{(1-z^b)+z^b(1-z^a)}{1-z^{a+b}}
=F_{a,b}.
\]
The same boundary values and induction on \(a+b\) give \(P_{a,b}=F_{a,b}\). Therefore
\[
H_Q(z)=z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_z.
\]

For \(a>0\), write \(\rho=(\rho_1,\ldots,\rho_a)\), allowing trailing zeroes, and define
\[
\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_a,\ldots,b-\rho_1).
\]
Since
\[
b-\rho_a\ge\cdots\ge b-\rho_1\ge0,
\]
this is again a partition in \(b^a\). It is an involution and
\[
|\rho^\vee|=ab-|\rho|.
\]
For \(a=0\), declare the unique empty partition self-complementary.

Define the integral bilinear form
\[
\langle e_\rho,e_\sigma\rangle=\delta_{\sigma,\rho^\vee}.
\]
If \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|=d\), then
\[
\deg e_{\rho^\vee}=ij+ab-|\rho|=2ij+ab-d.
\]
Thus it restricts to a perfect integral pairing
\[
Q_d\times Q_{\,2ij+ab-d}\longrightarrow\mathbb Z;
\]
in the displayed bases its matrix is a permutation matrix, hence unimodular.

The requested target is established, conditional on the accepted graded-basis statement.
